titles: What cosmic particles survive a spacewalk? 🚀
selected_title: What cosmic particles survive a spacewalk? 🚀 #Shorts
description: When astronauts return from a spacewalk, they often notice a unique smell—like a celestial barbecue. This aroma comes from polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, produced by dying stars. These molecules react with oxygen in the airlock, creating an intriguing smell. Learn more about this cosmic aroma and the science behind it! #Shorts #Astronomy #Space #Science #CosmicBarbecue #Astronauts #SpaceSmell #OuterSpace #AstronomyFact #SpaceOdyssey
